game.intro: New moon in Cancer, and the hermit crab is shopping for a bigger shell. Saturn wants three stories, one fake.
game.prompt: Three times you moved something from one place to another. Two true, one completely invented.

game.intro: The moon took off without leaving a note. Mischief is in charge. Ten seconds per pair, go!

game.question: You are handed a microphone with zero warning. What do you do with it?

game.intro: Focus day. The drawer is labelled, the label is crooked, and the camera is right up against it.
game.prompt: Something from inside a drawer you open every day, so close it becomes a mystery.

game.intro: Twin buttons, popped off in two towns at the same time. ΔΕΣ. Now answer this one wrong.
game.question: Why do shirts have buttons?

game.intro: The scales are wobbling. Patience. The crew wants something steady, then something not steady at all.
game.prompt: A rowboat gently knocking against a wooden dock, over and over, until it gets bored.

game.intro: A half-moon handshake under Libra. The tabloids were hiding in the bushes. Fill the blank.
game.headline: MOUNTAIN AND FIRE AGREE TO ___, SATURN DEMANDS A RECOUNT

game.intro: The diary is locked, but this answer is not. Scorpio moon says guess close and keep a secret.

game.source: The Canso Causeway officially opened on August 13, 1955 (Nova Scotia government and Canadian historical records).

game.intro: A lighthouse is blinking at you across the crossing. The crew blinks back. Three quick picks.

game.question: It is a hot August afternoon with nothing scheduled. Where do you end up?

game.intro: The sky started sparkling, so the crew wants sparkle up close. Very close. Uncomfortably close.
game.prompt: Something shiny or sparkly in your home, so close the light turns into a blur of stars.

game.intro: Shooting stars and a synchronized wish. Don't even scream. Saturn wants your worst astronomy.
game.question: What causes the shooting stars people watch for every August?

game.prompt: A surprise party at the exact moment the lights flick on and everyone forgets their line.

game.intro: The mountain is quietly applauding. Patience pays off. Spell your answer in tiny pictures.
game.prompt: Something you waited a very long time for, and it was worth it. Emoji only.

game.intro: Eve of the Sturgeon Moon and a feast in the air. Saturn will taste-test all three stories.
game.prompt: Three meals you remember from summers past. Two real, one invented and suspiciously delicious.

game.intro: Full Moon Recharge night. Ruby and onyx side by side. The crew is moving fast before moonrise.

game.question: You can invent one small gadget that will exist tomorrow. Which do you choose?
options: A pen that never wanders off

game.prompt: Something from your favourite resting spot: a cushion, a blanket, the arm of a chair. Get close.

game.question: What is the tide, and why does it keep coming back?

game.prompt: Somebody knocking on a door with a very particular secret rhythm that only friends would know.

game.intro: The Ram is throwing a parade in Aries and the newsroom ran out of ink. Fill in the headline.
game.headline: PARADE FOR ONE RAM DRAWS CROWD OF ___, MARCHING BAND DEEPLY CONFUSED

game.intro: Ten things started, zero finished, moon still in Aries. Count carefully before you release a guess.
game.question: Count every province and every territory in Canada together. How many are there?
game.source: Canada has 10 provinces and 3 territories (Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut since 1999) = 13.

game.intro: Slow garden day. Patience. The crew is watering the Lightning Round and it still came up fast.

game.question: You get to host one end-of-summer gathering. What kind is it?

game.prompt: Something that makes a noise when you use it, photographed so close it looks silent.

game.intro: Wonder day. Someone borrowed a word and never gave it back. Saturn wants the most wrong definition.
game.question: What does the word 'serendipity' mean?

game.prompt: Walking into your own home after a long day: keys, the door, the big sigh, the bag hitting the floor.

game.intro: Porch light on, waning moon in Cancer, nobody in a hurry. Rest your thumbs on a few emoji.
game.prompt: A perfect late-summer evening, from the first firefly to the last yawn, in emoji only.

game.intro: The last bonfire of summer, Leo moon roaring. Saturn wants campfire stories, one of them a whopper.
game.prompt: Three things that have happened to you around a campfire. Two true, one taller than the flames.

game.question: September is knocking. Which new-season ritual are you most excited about?
